title: Har129Artifact
description: One of the eleven JSON evidence files HAR-129 section H requires inside artifacts/har129/<run_id>/. Each file is an envelope: it names the run, records the status observed live, lists the requirement ids it evidences and the evidence references, and carries the payload under data. A file that no integrated execution filled is status not_run with empty evidence; it must never carry fabricated evidence.

artifact.description: The file name; manifest.json and demo-report.md are not artifacts of this shape.

requirement_ids.description: HAR-129 requirement ids this file will evidence once the run is real.

evidence.description: Machine-verifiable evidence references (ids, paths, digests). Empty until a real run fills them.

data.description: The payload for this file (records, snapshots, timelines). Empty object while no integrated run has filled it.
